field.name: display_archived_milestones
field.label: Display Archived Milestones in Select list
field.description: If set to yes, you will be able to see also archived milestones in milestones select list field on all forms

field.name: global_access
field.label: Global Access
field.description: This global access level group that is allow you to view/access component, Note: don't use it if you want access level to be based on project level.

fieldset.name: timeline_automation
fieldset.label: Timeline Automation
fieldset.description: Settings for automatic timeline adjustments in projects, milestones, and tasks when milestone timeline changed.

field.name: auto_extend_project
field.label: Auto-extend Project
field.description: When enabled, automatically extends project deadline when a milestone's end date is later than the current project deadline.

field.name: auto_extend_tasks
field.label: Auto-extend Tasks
field.description: When enabled, automatically extends task end dates when milestone end date is postponed. Closed tasks will not be affected.
